purpose: Measure degradation of the posed-superquadric extension under noise, gross outliers, random sparsity, and spatially coherent occlusion.
case_selection: The first nine cases form one complete 3x3 shape-stratum by aspect-stratum block and were used in the completed clean study.

occlusion_cap_80.construction: retain a contiguous top-projection surface cap

guided_pso.estimator_resolution: Use each case's clean-derived data_resolution and model_resolution unchanged for every condition.
guided_pso.estimator_density_preprocessing: none; robust support affects initialization only

ems.note: Existing clean/noise/outlier/random-missing fits are reused; coherent-occlusion fits are new. EMS is a specialized accuracy reference, not FE-matched to PSO.

independent_evaluation.reference: analytic area-uniform surface generated from trait.json

reporting.pso_within_condition: run-level median, IQR, and success rate; retain all five seeds
reporting.robustness_unit: per-case median under corruption paired with the same case's clean median
reporting.ems_comparison_unit: per-case Guided-PSO median paired with deterministic EMS
reporting.statistics: exact two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank over nine independent cases
reporting.failure_rule: Random missingness must not be described as occlusion; spatial-cap results are reported separately.
